scripts.predev: npm run kill-ports && npm run build -w @easymatch/shared
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run start:dev -w @easymatch/api" "npx wait-on -t 120000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4101/api/v1/health && npm run dev -w @easymatch/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @easymatch/shared && npm run build -w @easymatch/api && npm run build -w @easymatch/web
scripts.build:hostinger-web: npm run build -w @easymatch/shared && npm run build -w @easymatch/web && node scripts/hostinger-postbuild.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @easymatch/web && npm run lint -w @easymatch/api
